caption: The drawing shows a dress designed in a historical style, primarily in a soft blue color. The dress features a fitted bodice with a square neckline and long sleeves that end in ruffled lace cuffs, accented by blue ribbon bows. Decorative ruffles and vertical rows of gathered fabric run along the bodice, down the front, and around the hem of the overskirt. The skirt is full and has an open front revealing an underskirt decorated with multiple horizontal layers of gathered blue fabric and trim. To the right of the main dress illustration, there is a faint outline sketch of the same dress viewed from the back, indicating similar sleeve and skirt designs. The background is a plain off-white color, and the edges of the drawing are unembellished. The artist’s signature “RUELOS” is in small print at the bottom right corner.
title: Carriage Dress
